title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ojt7: FragmentReceiver rule_id is Option<u8> but used as u8
description:
In rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs (std_ext module, lines 1022, 1045, 1118-1120, 1172, 1190, 1215):
- rule_id is declared as Option<u8> at line 1022
- Initialized with literal 0 instead of Some(0) at line 1045
- Compared with integer 0 at line 1118 (should be None or Some(0))
- Assigned frag.rule_id (u8) at line 1119, compared at line 1120
- Passed as u8 to Ack::new() at lines 1172, 1190, 1215
Fix: either make rule_id u8 with a separate flag, or properly wrap/unwrap Option<u8> at all sites.
